subject.title: [Bug]: Discord elevated allowFrom fallback from channels.discord.allowFrom does not work on 2026.3.22

question: Should Discord elevated auth keep the shipped-docs fallback from `channels.discord.allowFrom`, or should OpenClaw require an explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` allowlist for elevated host exec?
rationale: The fallback would restore a released docs contract but also broadens the elevated host-exec authorization boundary when the explicit elevated allowlist is omitted.

options.title: Keep explicit elevated allowlists
options.body: Treat current main docs as the intended security contract, close this issue and the conflicting repair PRs with the explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` workaround.

options.title: Restore the Discord fallback
options.body: Sponsor a narrow Discord adapter/runtime and diagnostics fix with tests proving omitted fallback, explicit empty override, per-agent restriction, and Discord identity normalization.

options.title: Defer pending broader command-auth design
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the Slack and Telegram elevated-gating reports until maintainers choose one cross-channel authorization model.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit elevated allowlists
recommendation.body: Treat current main docs as the intended security contract, close this issue and the conflicting repair PRs with the explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` workaround.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the recent docs contract correction plus earlier elevated/sandbox feature history.
